title: Introduction to Python
short_description: An introductory session covering the main Python concepts.
full_description: This workshop introduces variables, data types, conditions, loops, and basic programming exercises.

title: Data Visualization with Power BI
short_description: A practical session on importing data and creating basic charts.
full_description: Students will import a prepared dataset and create charts and dashboards using Power BI.

title: Kaggle Mini Challenge
short_description: A team activity using a prepared dataset and evaluation metric.
full_description: Student teams will analyze a dataset and submit their results using a basic evaluation metric.

title: Machine Learning Basics
short_description: An overview of supervised learning and model evaluation.
full_description: This seminar introduces classification, regression, training data, testing data, and evaluation metrics.

title: AI Ethics Seminar
short_description: A discussion about privacy, fairness, and responsible AI.
full_description: The seminar discusses privacy, bias, transparency, fairness, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence.

title: Data Careers and CV Workshop
short_description: A session about data careers and improving technical CVs.
full_description: Students will learn about data-related careers and how to present their projects and technical skills in a CV.
